stem: Newly rooted clones are moved directly from very high humidity into a much drier production room and wilt. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: The transition may exceed their current root and stomatal capacity, so acclimatization should be gradual and monitored
High humidity must be maintained forever
rationale: Young rooted cuttings may need gradual acclimatization while root function and shoot water regulation adjust to lower humidity and higher demand.
